maplibre-gl.mjs.note: Fetched once from unpkg.com and vendored, exactly as assets/map/ vendors OSM tiles — a pinned local copy rather than a CDN reference with a floating semver range, which could not carry a Subresource Integrity hash. Used by home-map.js on the home page.

maplibre-gl.css.note: Fetched once from unpkg.com and vendored alongside maplibre-gl.mjs. Used by home-map.ts's MAPLIBRE_HEAD.

maplibre-gl-shared.mjs.note: A chunk maplibre-gl.mjs's own distribution splits into and imports itself at runtime — not something this project's code imports directly. Fetched once from unpkg.com and vendored alongside maplibre-gl.mjs, which 404s and fails to load without it.

maplibre-gl-worker.mjs.note: The background-thread chunk maplibre-gl-shared.mjs loads itself for its worker. Not imported by this project's code directly. Fetched once from unpkg.com and vendored alongside the other three files.
